# AI Data Index

> AI Data Index is a practical convention for publishing machine-readable website content through a structured JSON manifest and related discovery signals.

## Structured Data

- [AI Data Index manifest](https://aidataindex.org/json/index.json): Main JSON manifest describing this website and its AI-readable content structure.
- [Multilingual convention](https://aidataindex.org/#m_multilingual): Documentation for multilingual manifests and canonical multilingual entity files.
- [Agent setup Markdown](https://aidataindex.org/ai-data-index-agent-setup.md): Platform-neutral operational instructions for AI agents and assistants such as Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and other LLM-based tools that need to generate an AI Data Index integration.

## Website

- [Homepage](https://aidataindex.org/): Human-readable documentation for the AI Data Index protocol.
